tests.title: The binding schema creates token_workspace_bindings with the specified columns, index and no foreign key
given: an empty in-memory SQLite database
tests.when: wsaccess.InitBindingSchema(db) is called
then: the table token_workspace_bindings exists with columns token_id TEXT (primary key), slug TEXT NOT NULL and created_at TEXT NOT NULL
the index idx_token_workspace_bindings_slug exists on slug
PRAGMA foreign_key_list(token_workspace_bindings) returns no rows
a row inserted with apikit.NowUTC() as created_at is read back unchanged
tests.pseudocode: err = InitBindingSchema(db); assert err == nil; cols = pragma_table_info('token_workspace_bindings'); assert names(cols)==['token_id','slug','created_at']; assert pk(token_id) and notnull(slug) and notnull(created_at); assert 'idx_token_workspace_bindings_slug' in index_list; assert len(pragma_foreign_key_list)==0

tests.title: Re-running the binding schema initialisation leaves existing rows unchanged
given: token_workspace_bindings exists and holds two rows
tests.when: InitBindingSchema is called a second time
then: it returns a nil error
the row count is 2 before and after
the contents of both rows are identical before and after
tests.pseudocode: insert('t1','a',now); insert('t2','b',now); before = select_all(); assert InitBindingSchema(db)==nil; assert select_all()==before

tests.title: MountWorkspaceHandlers creates the binding table before the first request is served
given: a real apikit server and a fresh apikit database with no token_workspace_bindings table
tests.when: workspace.MountWorkspaceHandlers(server, db) returns and then any request is sent
then: MountWorkspaceHandlers returns nil
token_workspace_bindings exists in sqlite_master
the table was created after the workspaces table (its rowid in sqlite_master is greater) and a bound-token request in the first request succeeds without a missing-table 500
tests.pseudocode: err = MountWorkspaceHandlers(srv, db); assert err==nil; assert table_exists(db.SqlDB,'token_workspace_bindings'); assert rowid('token_workspace_bindings') > rowid('workspaces')

tests.title: MountGitHandlers creates the binding table so a PAT with a TokenID and no binding is not answered with 500
given: a test database with workspaces and pats tables but no token_workspace_bindings table
a workspace owned by the PAT's user with a cloned repository
an unbound PAT carrying a TokenID with git:read
tests.when: MountGitHandlers(e, db, root) is called and the PAT fetches info/refs of the owned repository
then: MountGitHandlers returns nil
token_workspace_bindings exists
the fetch is served (status 200) and is not a pkt-line 500
tests.pseudocode: assert MountGitHandlers(e, db, root)==nil; assert table_exists(db,'token_workspace_bindings'); r = get('/git/org/ws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', basic(pat)); assert r.status==200

tests.title: Both mount functions return an error and register nothing further when the binding table cannot be created
given: a database on which the binding DDL fails, for example an index named token_workspace_bindings already exists
for MountWorkspaceHandlers the workspaces schema itself succeeds
tests.when: MountWorkspaceHandlers and MountGitHandlers are called against that database
then: MountWorkspaceHandlers returns a non-nil error
MountGitHandlers returns a non-nil error
no git route is registered on the Echo instance after the failed MountGitHandlers call
tests.pseudocode: exec('CREATE INDEX token_workspace_bindings ON other(x)'); assert MountGitHandlers(e, db, root) != nil; assert len(e.Routes())==before; assert MountWorkspaceHandlers(srv, apikitDB) != nil

tests.title: Archiving or deleting a workspace leaves every binding row that names its slug unchanged
given: a workspace S owned by user u1
binding rows for two tokens naming S and one naming another slug
tests.when: S is archived through the API and then deleted through the API by its owner
then: the token_workspace_bindings row count is 3 after the archive and 3 after the delete
the contents of all three rows are equal to those before
tests.pseudocode: seed 3 rows; snap = rows(); archive('S'); assert rows()==snap; delete('S'); assert rows()==snap

tests.title: A PAT whose token id has no binding row is unbound
given: an initialised binding table with a row only for token tokB
tests.when: LookupBinding(db, 'tokX') and BoundSlug for a PAT with TokenID tokX are called
then: LookupBinding returns slug "", bound false, nil error
BoundSlug returns bound false and a nil error
LookupBinding for tokB returns the bound slug and true
tests.pseudocode: slug,bound,err = LookupBinding(db,'tokX'); assert !bound and err==nil

tests.title: The binding resolver issues no query for api_key, admin_token, nil auth or a PAT without a token id
given: a database handle that has been closed, so any query would return an error
a binding table that would otherwise hold rows
tests.when: BoundSlug is called with api_key, admin_token, nil AuthInfo and a PAT with empty TokenID
then: every call returns bound false and a nil error, which proves no query was issued
with a working database a PAT with TokenID is looked up by that TokenID
tests.pseudocode: db.Close(); for a in [apiKey, admin, nil, patNoTokenID]: s,b,err = BoundSlug(db,a); assert !b and err==nil

tests.title: The guard derives a missing token id from the Bearer header and writes the enriched AuthInfo back
given: a binding row for token id abc123 naming S
a test auth middleware that sets a PAT AuthInfo with empty TokenID
the binding guard behind that middleware and a probe handler that records apikit.GetAuthInfo(c)
tests.when: requests are sent with 'Authorization: Bearer af_pat_abc123_secret' and with 'authorization: bearer af_pat_abc123_secret'
then: the probe handler sees AuthInfo.TokenID == abc123 in both cases
other AuthInfo fields are unchanged
a request for a slug other than S is refused 404 showing the id was used to find the binding
tests.pseudocode: h = guard(db)(probe); req.Header.Set('Authorization','bearer af_pat_abc123_secret'); serve; assert probe.auth.TokenID=='abc123' and probe.auth.UserID==orig.UserID

tests.title: A PAT with no derivable token id is treated as unbound without a binding query
given: a closed database handle so any query would fail with an error
a PAT AuthInfo with empty TokenID
the binding guard and a probe handler
tests.when: requests are sent with no Authorization header, 'Basic xxx', 'Bearer af_pat_', 'Bearer af_pat__secret', 'Bearer af_apikey_xyz' and 'Bearer af_pat_noseparator'
then: each request reaches the probe handler with its normal status
no 500 is produced, which proves that no query was issued
tests.pseudocode: for h in headers: r = serve(h); assert r.status == probe_status and probe.called

tests.title: Every enforcing layer completes on a single-connection database without deadlock
given: an in-memory SQLite database with SetMaxOpenConns(1)
workspaces S and X owned by u1 and a binding row for token tokB naming S
tests.when: the following run for the bound PAT: GET /workspaces, GET /workspaces/S, GET /workspaces/X, wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace, GET /sessions and GET /audit
then: every call returns within 5 seconds
each returns its expected status, never a timeout or lock error
tests.pseudocode: db.SetMaxOpenConns(1); for call in calls: ok = within(5s, call); assert ok

tests.title: A binding lookup database error makes API routes answer 500 and the handler does not run
given: a PAT with a TokenID and a database whose token_workspace_bindings table has been dropped
tests.when: LookupBinding is called and a request goes through the binding guard
then: LookupBinding returns a non-nil error
the guard answers HTTP 500 with message internal server error
the probe handler is not called
the token is not treated as unbound
tests.pseudocode: drop table; _,_,err = LookupBinding(db,'t'); assert err!=nil; r = serve(guard(probe)); assert r.status==500 and r.msg=='internal server error' and !probe.called

tests.title: A bound token on a workspace-scoped route with another slug gets 404 before the handler runs
given: token tokB bound to S with no scopes at all
routes GET /workspaces/:slug and GET /workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id/events behind the guard
tests.when: the token requests /workspaces/X and /workspaces/X/runs/r1/events
then: both answers are HTTP 404 with the apikit error envelope and message workspace not found
the handler is not called, so no scope check produced a 403
tests.pseudocode: r = get('/workspaces/X'); assert r.status==404 and r.json.error.message=='workspace not found' and !handler.called

tests.title: A bound token on slug S gets exactly the response an unbound PAT with the same scopes gets
given: workspace S owned by u1
bound token tokB and unbound token tokU for u1 with identical scopes (once with workspaces:read, once without)
tests.when: both tokens request GET /workspaces/S and GET /workspaces/S/patches through the real handlers
then: status and body bytes are equal between tokB and tokU in each scope set
the scope-less case is the handler's own 403 for both
tests.pseudocode: assert resp(tokB).status==resp(tokU).status and resp(tokB).body==resp(tokU).body

tests.title: For any slug other than S, route and scope set, a bound token gets 404 workspace not found
given: token bound to S
workspace-scoped routes registered on the guarded group
tests.when: for any slug ≠ S (existing and owned, existing and archived, other owner's, non-existent), any workspace-scoped route and any subset of scopes including none
then: the status is 404
the message is workspace not found
the body equals the body a non-owner receives from the same route
the handler is never entered
tests.pseudocode: for slug,route,scopes in gen(): r = call(boundTok(scopes), route(slug)); assert r.status==404 and r.body==nonOwnerBody and !handler.called

tests.title: Routes and subgroups registered after the guard, including the runs subgroup, are guarded without further change
given: MountWorkspaceHandlers called on a real apikit server
audit.RegisterRoutes then registered on server.APIGroup() afterwards
a bound token for S
tests.when: the token posts to /workspaces/X/runs/r1/events and requests a workspace route added after mount
then: both answers are 404 workspace not found
with slug S the request reaches the audit handler
tests.pseudocode: MountWorkspaceHandlers(srv,db); audit.RegisterRoutes(srv.APIGroup(),...); api.GET('/workspaces/:slug/new', h); assert post(X runs).status==404; assert get(new route X).status==404

tests.title: AuthorizeWorkspace denies a bound PAT for an owned workspace other than S and allows S
given: owned workspaces S and X for u1
bound PAT with TokenID tokB naming S
tests.when: wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace is called for X and for S
then: for X it returns (nil, 404, "workspace not found")
for S it returns an access value equal to the one returned for an unbound PAT of u1
for a non-existent slug the existence check still answers 404 first
tests.pseudocode: a,code,msg = AuthorizeWorkspace(db,bound,'X'); assert a==nil and code==404 and msg=='workspace not found'; assert *AuthorizeWorkspace(db,bound,'S') == *AuthorizeWorkspace(db,unbound,'S')

tests.title: lookupWorkspaceForAuth applies the binding rule and writes 404 for another owned workspace
given: owned workspaces S and X for u1
an echo context with a bound PAT AuthInfo naming S and no guard in front
tests.when: lookupWorkspaceForAuth is called for X and for S
then: for X it writes HTTP 404 workspace not found and returns a non-nil error
for S it returns the workspace and a nil error
tests.pseudocode: ws,err = lookupWorkspaceForAuth(c,db,'X',bound); assert err!=nil and rec.Code==404

tests.title: A binding lookup failure inside AuthorizeWorkspace and lookupWorkspaceForAuth is a 500
given: an existing workspace owned by u1
the token_workspace_bindings table dropped after seeding
a PAT with a TokenID
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace and lookupWorkspaceForAuth are called for that workspace
then: AuthorizeWorkspace returns (nil, 500, "internal server error")
lookupWorkspaceForAuth writes HTTP 500 and returns a non-nil error
tests.pseudocode: drop table; a,code,msg = AuthorizeWorkspace(db,pat,'S'); assert code==500 and msg=='internal server error'

tests.title: A bound token on a non-workspace, non-allowlisted route gets 403 token_bound naming S
given: a route GET /widgets not on the allowlist, behind the guard
token bound to S with any scopes
tests.when: the token requests GET /widgets
then: status is 403
error_type is token_bound
message is exactly: this token is bound to workspace S
the handler is not called
tests.pseudocode: r = get('/widgets'); assert r.status==403 and r.json.error.error_type=='token_bound' and r.json.error.message=='this token is bound to workspace S'

tests.title: After all hub packages register their routes exactly the ten specified routes are on the allowlist
given: an Echo group on which workspace, audit, sandboxes, secrets, merge, forge and carrypatch RegisterRoutes have all been called as in main
tests.when: every registered route is tested against the wsaccess allowlist registry
then: the allowed set equals exactly GET /workspaces, POST /sessions, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id, POST /sessions/:id/complete, POST /sessions/:id/usage, GET /sessions/:id/usage, GET /audit, GET /events and GET /sandbox-profiles
POST /workspaces and GET /sandboxes are not in it
tests.pseudocode: allowed = [r for r in routes if wsaccess.IsAllowed(r.Method,r.Path)]; assert set(allowed)==EXPECTED10

tests.title: A bound token on an allowlisted route reaches the handler
given: GET /listing marked with AllowBoundTokens
token bound to S
tests.when: the token requests GET /listing
then: the handler runs
the guard adds no refusal and the handler's response is returned
tests.pseudocode: AllowBoundTokens(api.GET('/listing',h)); r=get('/listing'); assert h.called and r.status==200

tests.title: A bound token with full scopes is refused on POST /workspaces, user and org secrets and vars, and GET /sandboxes
given: real workspace, secrets and sandboxes routes registered behind the guard
a bound token holding workspaces:create, secrets and vars scopes
row counts of workspaces, secrets and variables
tests.when: the token sends POST /workspaces, POST /user/secrets, GET /user/vars, POST /orgs/o1/secrets, PUT /orgs/o1/vars/K and GET /sandboxes
then: every answer is HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound
the row counts of workspaces, secrets and variables are unchanged
tests.pseudocode: for (m,p) in cases: r=call(m,p); assert r.status==403 and r.error_type=='token_bound'; assert counts()==before

tests.title: A bound token requesting an unmatched path under the mount point is refused
given: the guard installed on the API group
token bound to S
tests.when: the token requests GET <mount>/no/such/path
then: status 403 with error_type token_bound
tests.pseudocode: r = get('/api/v1/no/such/path'); assert r.status==403 and r.error_type=='token_bound'

tests.title: For any later-registered route that is neither workspace-scoped nor allowlisted a bound token is refused
given: the guard installed first
token bound to S
tests.when: for any method and any path template registered afterwards that does not contain workspaces/:slug and was not passed to AllowBoundTokens
then: the bound token receives 403 token_bound
the route's handler is never called
tests.pseudocode: for m,p in gen_templates(): api.Add(m,p,h); r=call(m,p); assert r.status==403 and r.error_type=='token_bound' and !h.called

tests.title: Requests without credentials or with api_key, admin_token or unbound PAT pass the guard identically, without a binding query for non-PATs
given: a guard in front of a probe handler
a closed binding database for the no-credential, api_key and admin_token cases (a query would produce a 500)
a working database for the unbound PAT case
tests.when: requests are sent with no AuthInfo, an api_key, an admin_token and an unbound PAT on a non-allowlisted route
then: each reaches the handler with the status and body that the handler produces without the guard
none produces a 500

tests.title: MountWorkspaceHandlers records apikit's own routes and omits health routes
given: a real apikit server whose Echo route table is snapshotted before and after MountHandlers
tests.when: MountWorkspaceHandlers completes
then: the recorded apikit route set includes GET <mount>/user and POST <mount>/user/tokens
it contains no route that existed before MountHandlers
it does not contain /healthz, /readyz or /version
it contains no hub route such as GET <mount>/workspaces

tests.title: A bound PAT is refused on apikit's routes before authentication with a message that does not name the workspace
given: a real apikit server with MountWorkspaceHandlers
a PAT minted through apikit and a binding row for its id naming workspace secret-ws
tests.when: the PAT requests GET /api/v1/user, DELETE /api/v1/user/keys/k1 and GET /api/v1/orgs/o1
then: each answer is 403 with error_type token_bound and message this token is bound to a workspace
the body does not contain secret-ws
tests.pseudocode: for (m,p) in cases: r=call(m,p,boundPat); assert r.status==403 and r.msg=='this token is bound to a workspace' and 'secret-ws' not in r.body

tests.title: A bound PAT holding tokens:manage cannot mint a new PAT
given: a real apikit server with a bound PAT holding tokens:manage
the count of rows in apikit's pats table
tests.when: the PAT sends POST /api/v1/user/tokens with a valid creation body
then: the answer is 403 with error_type token_bound
the pats row count is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: n=count(pats); r=post('/api/v1/user/tokens',body,boundPat); assert r.status==403 and r.error_type=='token_bound'; assert count(pats)==n

tests.title: Requests on apikit routes with no af_pat_ id or an unbound id pass through unchanged
given: the apikit route guard with a recorded route GET /api/v1/user
a closed database for the cases with no af_pat_ id
tests.when: requests are sent with no Authorization header, a Bearer API key, and (with a working database) an af_pat_ token with no binding row
then: each is passed to the next handler with the status and body it would produce without the guard
no binding query is issued for the first two (no 500 on the closed database)
tests.pseudocode: assert guarded(req)==unguarded(req) for each

tests.title: The apikit route guard never sets AuthInfo, grants access or verifies a secret
given: the apikit route guard before a probe handler
a bound token id with a wrong secret and an unbound id with a wrong secret
tests.when: requests are sent on a recorded apikit route
then: the bound id is refused 403 regardless of secret correctness
the unbound id reaches the probe where apikit.GetAuthInfo(c) is nil
the guard source does not import a hashing or token verification package
tests.pseudocode: assert probe.auth==nil for unbound; assert refused(bound,wrongSecret)==refused(bound,rightSecret)

tests.title: Requests that match no recorded apikit route cause no binding query at the root guard
given: the apikit route guard on a closed database
a recorded route set
tests.when: a request with a bound-looking Bearer af_pat_ header is sent to a hub route and to an unknown path
then: both reach the next handler without a 500, so zero queries were issued
tests.pseudocode: db.Close(); r=serve('/api/v1/workspaces',bearer); assert r.status != 500

tests.title: A database error in the apikit route guard fails closed with 500

tests.when: a request with Bearer af_pat_<id>_secret hits that route
then: the answer is 500 with message internal server error

tests.pseudocode: r=serve(); assert r.status==500 and r.msg=='internal server error' and !next.called

tests.title: GET /workspaces returns at most S for a bound token
given: u1 owns S, X (active) and A (archived) and A is S in the archived variant
bound token with workspaces:read, a second bound token without it

tests.title: POST /sessions with another workspace or an idempotent replay of another workspace's session is 404

tests.title: Reading a session or usage outside S, or listing another slug, is 403 workspace access denied
given: a session in X and a session in S

then: all three answer 403 workspace access denied
tests.pseudocode: for p in paths: r=get(p); assert r.status==403 and r.msg=='workspace access denied'

tests.title: GET /sessions without a slug lists only S's sessions

token bound to S
tests.when: GET /sessions is called

all items carry workspace_slug S and at least one is returned

token bound to S

tests.title: GET /audit and GET /events return only S's events for a bound token
given: audit events in S and X for u1
token bound to S
tests.when: GET /audit and GET /events are called
then: the answers are 200 (SSE stream for /events)
every event carries workspace S and S's events are present
tests.pseudocode: assert all(e.workspace=='S' for e in get('/audit').events); assert all(e.workspace=='S' for e in read_sse('/events'))

tests.title: GET /audit?workspace=<other> is 404 workspace not found for a bound token
given: owned workspace X and token bound to S
tests.when: GET /audit?workspace=X is called

tests.title: GET /sandbox-profiles answers a bound token exactly as an unbound PAT

a bound and an unbound PAT with the same user and scopes
tests.when: both request GET /sandbox-profiles
then: status and body are equal

tests.title: A bound token requesting another owned repository gets the non-owner pkt-line 404

given: a bound token and an unbound PAT with identical user and scopes
tests.when: for any scope subset, any registered route (API and git) and any slug
then: if the bound token's request is not refused by the guard (status not 404/403 token_bound), the unbound PAT's response has the same status and body
no 2xx for the bound token has a non-2xx for the unbound PAT
tests.pseudocode: for scopes,route,slug in gen(): b=call(bound); u=call(unbound); if 200<=b.status<300: assert u.status==b.status

tests.title: A bound token still reaches its archived workspace and gets the usual archived responses
given: S archived
bound and unbound owner PATs with the same scopes
tests.when: both PATs attempt a mutating call on S (for example update or sync) and a read
then: the bound PAT receives the same 400 or 409 as the unbound PAT
the read reaches the handler and not the guard's 404
tests.pseudocode: assert resp(bound,'PATCH','/workspaces/S')==resp(unbound,'PATCH','/workspaces/S')

tests.title: A token whose bound workspace was deleted fails closed everywhere
given: a binding row naming S and S deleted
a bound PAT
tests.when: the PAT requests GET /workspaces/S, GET /user/secrets and fetches /git/org/S.git
then: GET /workspaces/S is 404 workspace not found
GET /user/secrets is 403 token_bound
git fetch is the pkt-line 404 repository not found
tests.pseudocode: assert get('/workspaces/S').status==404; assert get('/user/secrets').error_type=='token_bound'; assert git_fetch('S').status==404

tests.title: A bound token reads its own workspace and is refused another through the running hub
given: a real apikit server with a real database and MountWorkspaceHandlers
users's PAT minted through apikit with workspaces:read
workspaces S and X owned by the user and a binding row for the PAT naming S
tests.when: the PAT requests GET /api/v1/workspaces/S and then GET /api/v1/workspaces/X/patches
then: the first answer is 200 with workspace S
the second is 404 workspace not found
the unbound twin PAT gets 200 on both

tests.title: A bound PAT with tokens:manage cannot mint a PAT through the running hub
given: a real apikit server with MountWorkspaceHandlers
a bound PAT holding tokens:manage
tests.when: the PAT sends POST /api/v1/user/tokens
then: the answer is 403 token_bound with message this token is bound to a workspace
apikit's pats table has no new row

tests.title: A bound PAT is refused on a non-allowlisted hub route through the running hub
given: a real hub with secrets routes registered
a bound PAT
tests.when: the PAT requests GET /api/v1/user/secrets
then: the answer is 403 with error_type token_bound and message this token is bound to workspace S

tests.title: A bound token discovers its workspace, reports a session and reads its audit stream
given: a real hub with workspace and audit routes registered
a bound PAT with workspaces:read, sessions:write and audit:read
S and X owned by the user with events in both
tests.when: the PAT calls GET /workspaces, POST /sessions with workspace_slug S and GET /audit
then: the list holds only S
the session is created with 201
the audit result holds only events of S

tests.title: A bound token fetches its own repository and is refused another through the running git server
given: a running hub with MountGitHandlers and real bare repositories for S and X
a bound PAT with git:read used as Basic auth password
tests.when: the PAT fetches /git/org/S.git and then /git/org/X.git
then: the fetch of S serves the refs
the fetch of X returns a pkt-line 404 repository not found
